dataset: LibriSpeech test-clean, exploratory, fixed historical checkpoints, Phone69
pairing: CSV idx to lexicographically sorted FLAC stems. Validated reference sequence against each chapter -ph.trans.txt after filtering spn, and all source CSV hashes against experiments.json.
alignment: Unit-cost Levenshtein, ties match > substitution > deletion > insertion. S/D assigned to reference category, I counted separately. Vowel group is the ARPABET trailing stress digit.

interval.algorithm: default_rng(42).integers(0,40,(10000,40)) over sorted numeric speaker IDs, jointly across systems. Sum errors over sum references per resample. Two-sided np.quantile([0.025,0.975]). Covers speaker sampling conditional on the checkpoints.

speech_rate.definitions: Reference phones / full FLAC duration (including pauses) x 60. Natural speech. Retain all original 10 equal-utterance bins, with numeric PPM rounded to two decimals as in source. Slow=deciles 1–3, middle=4–7, fast=8–10 selected for this exploratory pilot. Bootstrap as above using one common speaker draw for all strata and models.

frame_source.E10: Per-utterance recorded counts. Validated stage totals against mel_layer5_compute.json.
frame_source.E01: Per-utterance ceiling(raw mel / 4); corpus total validated against the measured E01 frame ledger.
